summary.text: Howard Pearl is a Republican state senator from New Hampshire who has represented District 17 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, his career experience includes owning Pearl & Sons Farm LLC.

paragraphs.text: Pearl served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Merrimack 26 from 2016 to 2022 before assuming office in the State Senate on December 7, 2022.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Executive Departments and Administration Committee, is vice chair of the Energy and Natural Resources Committee, and serves on the Senate Finance Committee.
